disqualifier.note: Two stored workbench boolean atoms in Session.atoms.ts: inferred-view is a user toggle and auto-open is a one-shot first-run latch. Writers never pair them; all 4 combinations are legal (bootstrap can fire with inferred on or off, and later inferred toggles leave the latch true).
Sibling pane overlays in one module, each projecting AsyncResult.isWaiting for a different query (queue vs candidate detail). Both-true is the legal refresh-both case, not a masked union.
